entries.2dccc3d403ff9d15: It has been advancing its 12th Medium-Term Management Plan since fiscal 2022, and in light of changes in the business environment and performance trends, it extended the final year by 2 years and revised the plan. It states that it will promote expansion of the business centered on the Fine Chemicals Business, reform of the business portfolio, management with awareness of capital efficiency, strengthening of IR activities, and reduction of policy-held shares. In the Iron-Based Business, it completed in fiscal 2025 the transfer of carrier product manufacturing to Kanto Denka Finetech Co., Ltd., and states that it will concentrate the management resources of its former manufacturing base on the Fine Chemicals Business. It also states that it will complete as planned the lithium-ion secondary battery recycling plant it decided to build and contribute to realizing a recycling-oriented society. The numerical targets of the plan are matters concerning the future, so they are not reproduced here.
